title: CryptoDaily Brief
tagline: CryptoDailyBrief is a daily personalized crypto insights platform, blending on-chain data (via The Graph) and off-chain sentiment (e.g., YouTube trends) into concise briefs. Powered by an Autonome AI agent for real-time portfolio advice, it streamlines your Web3 experience.
description: CryptoDailyBrief unifies crypto intelligence into a single dashboard to help users make informed decisions quickly. By tapping both on-chain sources (via The Graph) and off-chain signals like social media sentiment, CryptoDailyBrief analyzes wallet balances, highlights market-moving trends, and provides tailored action items—be it rebalancing, tax optimization, or yield-farming strategies. An AI agent, deployed on Autonome, can respond to user queries in real-time and even execute transactions on-chain using AgentKit from Coinbase. The user experience is enhanced through a chat-based interface that makes advanced Web3 interactions accessible to both seasoned and novice crypto holders.
how_its_made:
Architecture & Tech Stack:
Frontend in Next.js for a responsive UI showing real-time on-chain/off-chain data.
Backend in Node.js/Express for data aggregation, orchestrating requests to AI agents, and bridging The Graph queries.
AI Agent deployed on Autonome, leveraging Coinbase’s AgentKit for on-chain wallet operations (ERC1155, ERC20, ERC721).
Smart Contracts deployed on Base (Sepolia) and managed with Foundry for robust contract testing.
Data Indexing via The Graph, enabling swift retrieval of transaction and balance info for multiple addresses.
Integration & Notable Hacks:
Built custom Docker images for the AI agent, ensuring it meets Autonome’s entrypoint requirements and health-check protocol.
Combined social media sentiment (e.g., YouTube API) with The Graph’s on-chain data to produce a daily “confidence score.”
Employed a chat-based design, allowing natural language commands that the AI agent interprets into direct on-chain actions.
By weaving these components together, CryptoDailyBrief presents investors with a streamlined platform that harnesses the power of AI, multi-chain data, and user-friendly interactions—ultimately driving more informed, confident decision-making in the ever-evolving crypto landscape.
